title: Date-emphasized clock
description: Inverts the usual clock hierarchy: the time shrinks toward the size of a label while the date line grows and switches from muted to full ink weight, making the date the visually dominant piece of the header clock block. Purely a size/weight relationship within the clock, distinct from category D's date-forward layouts.

changes.intent: Shrink the time so it no longer dominates the header block.
Grow the date and lift it from muted to full ink so it reads as the emphasized value, re-mapping its color token rather than inventing a new hue.
